places-vizcaya-bridge-chaussee-et-tunnel.story: From Portugalete it runs 260 km to Portugalete; allow about 4 h 29 of riding. On the way it passes Santimamiñe, Ekain, Chaussée et Tunnel de San Adrian and back through Ekain. The line favours views over speed.

places-levoca-and-the-work-of-master-pau.story: 179 km from Levoča to Levoča, about 3 h 05 of riding. The stops in between: Dobšinská Ice Cave, Component of Koniar plateau, Component neighbouring Silica and Jasov and back through Component of Koniar plateau. The highest point is about 800 m. The line favours views over speed.
